profile.headline: Software and Project Management
profile.summary:
SENIOR SOFTWARE MANAGER & SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER

Disciplined, goal-oriented software development manager spanning multiple industries. A proven problem solver with an engineering mind, business development drive, and a customer relations personality who excels at leading software development and customer support teams in a cross functional organization through difficult programs to achieve strategic goals. A key member of the leadership team that creates and executes product delivery strategy, drives product development, and is frequently sought-after to manage at risk areas, while fostering collaborative relationships with technology leaders and business stakeholders. Extensive cross-cultural and international experience with the ability to learn new technologies and domains quickly. Core competencies include:

Software Management | Software Engineering | Team Leadership | Mentoring | Customer Relations 
Requirements Gathering | Risk Assessment | Process Improvement | System Monitoring
Continuous Deployment | Testing | Advanced Degree | Fluency in English & Japanese

positions.title: Staff Engineer/Software Manager
positions.description:
- Manage a team of 4 software engineers
- IoT devices for commercial management of rental properties:locks, leak detectors, lights, thermostats
- Microservice architecture: gRPC, Protobuf, Java, Python, Mongo, DynamoDB, AWS IoT, AWS ECS, Lambda, Terraform, DataDog, Spring Boot
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Project Management · Multithreading · Debugging · Computer Science · Linux · Embedded Software · Team Management · Engineering Management · Project Coordination · Systems Engineering · Data Visualization · Customer Support · Business Process Improvement · Microservices · Java · Technical Leadership · Software Architecture · Amazon Redshift · MySQL · Object Oriented Design · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Process Improvement · Distributed Systems · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Embedded Systems · Performance Metrics · DynamoDB · Workflow Automation · Relational Databases · Internet of Things (IoT) · Remote Function Call (RFC) · Test Automation · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrating robotics solutions for moving material within a warehouse.
- Utilizing cloud and edge solutions to orchestrate and monitor work
- IoT/Greengrass solutions
- High scalability and availability with automated issue detection
- AWS: DynamoDB, IoT, Greengrass, Lambda, Fargate
- Provisioning and Orchestration of 100s of robots through edge/cloud based software deployments

positions.title: Software Engineer/Software Manager
positions.description:
Worked on the client side of Kiva Systems supporting the needs of the non-Amazon customers.  Developed instrumentation system which identified system failures and weaknesses allowing us to resolve customer issues before they had adverse affects on site.

- Job management for material handling solutions using message driven agents
- Deep dive into legacy code to identify design and implementation issues, and resolved
- Team lead for feature development
- Database and system optimization to handle ever increasing load and higher system throughput
- Final year managed all client software teams, customer support, and QA

positions.title: Software Product Manager
positions.description:
Worked at Teradyne's ATD division in North Reading, MA.

Developed a test sequencer integrating with a wide variety of test instruments and software add-ins.  Provides the GUI for development and operator interface.
- Windows GUI development
- Fiber channel embedded aircraft tester
- Software development for multiple hardware test platforms

positions.title: MSD Software Support Manager
positions.description:
Manage a multi-national group of software engineers responsible for resolving customer specific issues, and development of custom solutions.  This position requires regular interaction with Japanese customers to identify and resolve their issues.  Worked with customer management teams to identify development needs, and managed teams in US, Japan, and India to produce timely solutions.

Process development, multi-customer relationships and escalations, Japanese communications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on IG-900 software for the J996 specializing in Memory Fail Processing.   Transferred to Semiconductor Test Division to work on UltraFLEX test platform.  Transitioned to expat role in Japan Business Unit in Kumamoto, Japan working as software manager for the UltraFLEX software group and rapid customer escalation support.  The Japan team was a cross between software development and customer support.

Responsibilities include: team management, project management, software development, tiger team response, process creation, process compliance monitoring, and customer support.

positions.title: Summer Intern/Contractor
positions.description: Ported GNU tools (Emacs, sed, awk, lex, yacc, etc.), OSF OS, and X-windows to 64-bit custom processor, kernel debugging, software quality work, and software development.  Tool smithing.
positions.insights: Skills: Multithreading · Debugging · Computer Science · Technical Leadership · Workflow Automation · Test Automation

positions.title: Intern - Software Development
positions.description: Developed simulator on the Metric fast context switching CPU.  GUI for command and control system using X-11.

positions.title: Summer Intern - Quality assurance
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description: Worked on quality testing of DBase III and Framework III products for Unix and Windows platforms.
